newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was moderate late Friday. Slaughter steers and heifers ended fully steady.

Inquiry and demand were moderate. Sales confirmed on 6,800 slaughter steers and 3,700 slaughter heifers. Last week's confirmed sales 54,300 head including 16,800 head or about 31 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 72.00, few 71.00-71.50; mixed Commercial to Choice 1175-1200 lbs heifers and heiferettes 70.00-71.00. Confirmed: 10500 last week: 100 last year: 2700
